name: @openllmsh/dsh
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle that routes the harness through the OpenLLM gateway (OpenAI-compatible) and registers the OpenLLM MCP server, with a boot-time install bridge for the OpenLLM CLI + daemon (credential onboarding is OpenLLM's own — `openllm start`).
//dshRuntimeRequires: Provided by the host DeepSeek Harness at runtime (not installable standalone — their preview npm graph pulls the unpublished @deepseek-ai/dsh-environment): @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess, @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands, @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions, @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai, @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. This bundle only patches/uses them via cordis.patch.yml + the ambient shim in src/dsh-augment.d.ts.
